phases.title: Knowledge Graph v1
phases.done_when: All four milestones are done: changes checked automatically, known data errors fixed, graph matches the database, anyone can browse it and get answers.
phases.what: One connected, checked map of everything in the BBQS database: people, projects, institutions, working groups, species, datasets and tools. Anyone can browse it on the website.

milestones.title: Changes are checked automatically
milestones.done_when: Every change to the graph runs the automatic checks, and a reviewer must approve changes to it.
milestones.what: Nothing can quietly break the knowledge graph: every change is checked before it lands.
milestones.now: Done (2026-09-30). The checks run on every change, and the knowledge-graph files need the owner's review.

milestones.title: Known data errors are fixed
milestones.done_when: The graph's consistency checks report 0 errors.
milestones.what: The facts the checks flagged as wrong are corrected at the source: six projects get real species, BARD.CC its current award number, Psych-DS is filed as a standard, and a duplicate person record is merged.

milestones.title: The graph matches the database
milestones.done_when: At least 95% of the database's facts are in the graph, and fewer than 10% of records are unconnected.
milestones.what: Every person, project, institution, working group, dataset and tool is in the graph and connected the way the database says, so the database could be rebuilt from it.

measures.label: Database facts carried in the graph

milestones.title: Anyone can browse it and get answers
milestones.done_when: The browsable page is live and refreshed daily, and at least 15 of the 19 standard questions get an answer.
milestones.what: A page on brain-bbqs.org shows the graph and how complete it is, and the graph answers the everyday questions people ask about BBQS.

measures.label: Database facts carried in the graph

phases.title: BBQS MCP: answers and data fixes through the knowledge graph
phases.done_when: Its three milestones are done: answers come from the knowledge graph, curators make data fixes through it, members can connect and use it.
phases.what: The BBQS MCP server is how the BBQS assistant, and any AI tool a member connects, reads and updates BBQS data. This phase makes it answer from the knowledge graph's checked facts, with the source of each answer, gives curators a tool for every routine data fix, and documents it so members can use it.

milestones.title: Answers come from the knowledge graph
milestones.done_when: The MCP's knowledge-graph tools answer the standard questions with the same results the graph's own checks get, and every answer carries its source.
milestones.what: Questions asked through the BBQS MCP are answered from the knowledge graph's checked facts, and each answer says where it came from.

milestones.title: Curators make data fixes through it
milestones.done_when: Each routine kind of data fix has an MCP curator tool.
milestones.what: Every routine data fix (a project's species, a renumbered award, a resource, a duplicate person) is made through an MCP tool that records who changed what, never by hand-written SQL.
milestones.now: Tools exist for renumbered awards, species and resources; merging duplicate people and changing a resource's type are still missing.

milestones.title: Members can connect and use it
milestones.done_when: The MCP docs and tutorial list every tool and its access level, and a check keeps them in step with the server.
milestones.what: A member can connect the BBQS MCP to their AI tool and know what each tool does and who may use it.
milestones.now: Docs exist but are not checked against the server's tool list.

phases.title: Website and community
phases.what: The public website and the processes around it: what the community can see, how work is tracked, and how progress is reported.

phases.title: Community content: publications, resources, datasets
phases.what: Bringing BBQS publications, resources and datasets into one place the community can use, built on the knowledge graph.

phases.title: Knowledge Graph v2 (later)
phases.done_when: To be defined once Knowledge Graph v1 is done.
phases.what: Work that improves the graph but is deliberately not part of v1, so that v1 can close: device and sensor detail (SOSA, including the workshop's sensor registry and PR #433, paused), more consistency checks, and schema housekeeping.
